mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances when FEDFUNDS shows a sustained downward trend over 6 months, or the 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 1% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not exceed a 1% monthly increase in the trigger month, or the 5d returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and PAYEMS (labor) indicate expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both proxies increase in the same month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or PAYEMS does not increase in the same month, or the 20d returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 exceeds 200,000 and FEDFUNDS falls below 5.0%, it signals a late-cycle expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 ≤ 200,000 or FEDFUNDS ≥ 5.0% in the same month, or the 60d returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A FEDFUNDS crossing above 5.5% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over 20 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not cross above 5.5% in the relevant period, or the 20d returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE drop below 3.5% signals labor market improvement, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 3.5% in the trigger month, or the 5d returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO crossing above 105 indicates robust supply growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 105 in the relevant month, or the 20d returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) suggest strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both proxies increase in the same month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO does not increase in the same month, or the 60d returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).
